function.name: get_order_details
function.description: Retrieve order details: line items, customer info (loyalty tier), payment method, dates, and totals. Always call this first.

function.name: get_fulfillment_status
function.description: Get per-item shipping/fulfillment status (processing/shipped/delivered/lost), delivery dates, late_delivery flag, days_late, days_since_delivery.

function.name: check_resolution_policy
function.description: Verify whether a specific item is eligible for the customer's requested resolution (refund / exchange / replacement) given the customer's loyalty tier, item category, return window, and the reason.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Check stock for a SKU. Call ONLY when processing an exchange.

function.name: calculate_resolution
function.description: Compute refund amounts, restocking fees, credits for the full list of item actions before submitting the resolution.

function.name: submit_resolution
function.description: Finalize the resolution. ONLY call after calculate_resolution has confirmed amounts.
